description:
Study ghost app on rainy days!

Do you like studying on rainy days? Then this app is perfect! 

This is a special study friend.

It has the following characteristics:

**Cute ghost characters**: 

Our little ghost makes your study time more attractive as you focus on your studies.

**Pomodoro & Primary Timer**:

Whether you prefer the Pomodoro technique or want a regular timer, it's all on offer.

**Statistics of study**

Keep track of your study progress and gain insight into your study habits.

**Song Library**

Set the tone with songs to cheer up or enjoy the rain by studying.

Personal Confidence & D-Day Settings

Set a countdown for personal messages or special study goals for motivation you need

Add a magical touch to your study routine. Study Rainy Days Make rainy days productive every time with the ghost app! **Study ghost app on rainy days!**
